data.description: Luxury Office with Burj Khalifa Views in Burj Capital Business Bay
data.long_description:
Located in the prestigious Burj Capital, this premium office space offers a modern business environment in the heart of Dubai’s commercial hub. The building features five basement parking levels, an elegant ground-floor lobby, and three podium floors designed to support a dynamic professional lifestyle.

The office boasts high-quality finishes and flexible layouts, allowing businesses to customize the space according to their operational needs. Large windows and private balconies offer breathtaking panoramic views of the iconic Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Canal, and the surrounding green city park.

Tenants benefit from world-class amenities including executive offices, collaboration zones, wellness and fitness rooms, green terraces, and relaxing lounge areas. With intelligent access systems, valet parking, and high-end retail and F&B outlets, Burj Capital provides a sophisticated address for growing businesses.
